project.title: Native HTTP password-bound backup-code management
project.goal: Deliver explicit own remaining-code view and confirmed replacement through native HTTP and retained React without uncertain disclosure/replay
project.scope: Synthetic native HTTP and React backup management; no live writer grant or deployed browser/cutover parity

password.description: Exact current password, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes. Sole JSON object field; no caller subject.

output.description: Known committed success only; fixed refusals described by errors. No codes after unknown outcome.

backupCodes.description: Canonical unique remaining0..10 for view or fresh10 for regeneration

errors.refused: Strict HTTP refusal;401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS or503 AUTH_UNCONFIRMED without codes/cookies/success

preconditions: Trusted origin/profile/current-session proof and admitted native handler retained by serving owner
Physical/lifetime admission and exclusive legacy writer routing before real enablement
postconditions: Only known commit returns strict status:true and remaining0..10 or fresh10 code list, no session cookie
Native Fresh/password/credential snapshot/factor/access fences and atomic audit stay authoritative
New codes replace old ones; unknown commit withholds disclosure without unchanged-pool/audit claim
React explicit password+confirmation/retry0/strict pool validation; hide/unmount epoch discards late disclosure without automatic fallback or regeneration
external_effects: Admitted native view audit or encrypted-pool replacement plus audit
Bounded process rate/capacity and plaintext known-success authenticated HTTP body
Ephemeral modal state and explicit user confirmation/disclosure only
